description: This file configures server-specific settings for an Angular application, including providers for server rendering, environment variables, and title management, and merges these into the overall application configuration.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Interface defining the application's configuration structure, including providers and other settings.

classes.name: AppTitleStrategy
classes.description: Custom implementation of TitleStrategy used for setting document titles in the app.

methods.name: mergeApplicationConfig
methods.description: Function that merges multiple application configurations into a single configuration object.

methods.name: provideServerRendering
methods.description: Function that provides server rendering support in Angular, enabling SSR features.

methods.name: provideEnvironment
methods.description: Function that provides environment-specific configuration, possibly reading from process.env.
